name: Azure Monitor
summary: Send Ogun metrics to Azure Monitor custom metrics and events to a Log Analytics table through the Logs Ingestion API, with Microsoft Entra ID.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.label: Client secret
fields.help: Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

auth.label: Managed identity of the exporter host

settings.name: region
settings.label: Region
settings.help: The region of the resource that custom metrics are reported against.

settings.name: resource_id
settings.label: Azure resource ID
settings.help: The resource that custom metrics are reported against.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Data collection endpoint host
settings.help: Host only, from the data collection endpoint in the Azure portal. For the Logs Ingestion API.

settings.name: dcr_immutable_id
settings.label: Data collection rule immutable ID
settings.help: Starts with dcr-. For the Logs Ingestion API.

settings.name: stream_name
settings.label: Stream name
settings.help: The stream of the data collection rule that receives events.

egress.note: login.microsoftonline.com is only for Entra ID.

notes: Metrics, to custom metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events, to the Logs Ingestion API: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.
